Solve a natural language processing problem that interests you! This is an open-ended assignment. You can of course use deep learning frameworks for this exercise like tensorflow or you can use [scikit-learn (Links to an external site.)](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/) to have access to tons of other machine learning algorithms.

You can find a lot of datasets here: [https://www.kaggle.com/datasets (Links to an external site.)](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets)

Do some preliminary exploratory analysis of your data (like we did in lecture 10.01).

You should upload a Jupyter notebook where the experiments are already completed (you have the output of the cells in the notebook).

If you need computing power and you don't have a GPU you may want to use Google Colab to access GPU-s for free: [https://colab.research.google.com (Links to an external site.)](https://colab.research.google.com/). You can download the Jupyter notebook from Colab using File=>Download.ipynb.

The steps you take should be about these:

1. Choose a dataset
2. Open it in your notebook
3. Explore it in your notebook
4. Train a model on it
5. Test the model on it

**You have to present and explain your notebook in person on the 12th week practice to get the full 9 points, or on the 13th week practice to get 6 points.**
